title: Octanuclear [NiII4LnIII4] complexes. Synthesis, crystal structures and magnetocaloric properties

material_class.structural_family: octanuclear Ni4Ln4 cluster with phenoxo, carbonato and azido bridges

synthesis.procedure: A solution of 0.1 mmol NaN3 in 10 mL H2O was added to a solution of 0.1 mmol of the corresponding [NiII(valpn)SmIII] heterodinuclear complex in 20 mL acetonitrile. The mixture was stirred for 30 minutes and filtered. Slow vaporization of the solvent over several days yielded green crystals of 1. The dinuclear precursor was prepared from 4 mmol Ln(NO3)3·6H2O added to a suspension of 4 mmol [Ni(valpn)] in 20 mL acetonitrile, stirred about 20 minutes and allowed to evaporate at room temperature. [Ni(valpn)] itself was prepared from 20 mmol o-vanillin in 50 mL THF with 10 mmol 1,3-propylenediamine and 20 mmol triethylamine (30 min), then 10 mmol Ni(NO3)2·6H2O in 50 mL water, stirred 1 h, precipitated with 500 mL water.
synthesis.time: stirred 30 min; crystals after several days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution mixing, filtration, slow solvent vaporization in air (atmospheric CO2 capture)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; slow vaporization of solvent yielded green crystals

properties.summary: Compound 1 was prepared as a structural analogue to show that atmospheric CO2 fixation is general; magnetic and optical properties were not reported for the Sm complex.

material_class.structural_family: octanuclear Ni4Ln4 cluster with phenoxo, carbonato and azido bridges

synthesis.procedure: A solution of 0.1 mmol NaN3 in 10 mL H2O was added to a solution of 0.1 mmol of the corresponding [NiII(valpn)GdIII] heterodinuclear complex in 20 mL acetonitrile. The mixture was stirred for 30 minutes and filtered. Slow vaporization of the solvent over several days yielded green crystals of 2. The dinuclear precursor was prepared from 4 mmol Ln(NO3)3·6H2O added to a suspension of 4 mmol [Ni(valpn)] in 20 mL acetonitrile, stirred about 20 minutes and allowed to evaporate at room temperature.
synthesis.time: stirred 30 min; crystals after several days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution mixing, filtration, slow solvent vaporization in air (atmospheric CO2 capture)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; slow vaporization of solvent yielded green crystals

properties.summary: The Ni4Gd4 cluster shows weak competitive Ni–Gd, Gd–Gd and Ni–Ni exchange, a nearly temperature-independent χMT down to 50 K, then a slight rise and a low-T drop. Magnetization approaches ~35 NAμB at 7 T without full saturation. Specific heat shows a zero-field Schottky anomaly peaking at 1 K. A significant magnetocaloric effect is spread over ~1–20 K, with ΔSm[0–7 T] = 19 J kg−1 K−1 at 3.5 K and still >5 J kg−1 K−1 at 20 K.
